verses.text: By David. I’ll thank you with all my heart. Right in front of the gods, I’ll sing your praise.
I’ll bow toward your holy temple and thank you for your name, your faithful love, and your truth. You’ve lifted your name and your word above everything.
The day I called, you answered. You gave me fresh courage and strength deep inside.
Every king on earth will thank you, LORD, because they’ve heard what you said.
They’ll sing about your ways, LORD, because your glory is so great!
Even though the LORD is high above us, he looks after people who are lowly. He recognizes the proud from far away.
Even when I’m walking right through trouble, you keep me alive. You reach out against my enemies’ rage, and your right hand saves me.
The LORD will finish what concerns me. Your faithful love lasts forever, LORD. Don’t walk away from what your own hands have made.
